summary: BUG-660 fix testing on order #021115 (prashant/9535004327). Core V1 fix is working - Credit panel opens with prefilled name+phone, NO CRM dropdown auto-opens. V3/V7 also pass. V5 has a bug: phone suggestions appear after name edit (should stay closed). V12: suggestion elements exist in JSX but use conditional rendering (not in DOM when empty - acceptable).

ui_bugs.issue: V5 FAIL: After editing name field (append 'x'), the phone suggestions dropdown opens (shows 'prashant / 9535004327'). Root cause: handleTabNameChange calls setTabIsCustomerSelected(false) which triggers the phone search useEffect (tabIsCustomerSelected is in its deps). With phone still set to '9535004327', CRM search fires and returns results, showing phone dropdown. Expected: phone dropdown should stay closed when only name field is edited.

V11 partial: After switching from Credit → Cash, the CRM name input still exists in DOM (Credit tab stays selected). This may be a timing/overlay issue in test - initial Cash state correctly shows NO CRM fields. Needs manual verification.

action_items: V5 BUG: When name field is edited (setTabIsCustomerSelected=false in handleTabNameChange), the phone search useEffect re-fires because tabIsCustomerSelected is in its deps. Fix: in phone search effect, also check a 'phoneChangedRef' or track last-changed-field to prevent phone search from firing when only name was edited. File: CollectPaymentPanel.jsx lines 561-580
critical_code_review_comments: CollectPaymentPanel.jsx L561-580: Phone search useEffect depends on [tabPhone, tabIsCustomerSelected, isTabPayment]. When name edit resets tabIsCustomerSelected=false, the phone effect runs even though tabPhone didn't change. This is correct per React rules but causes phone dropdown to open on name edit (V5 failure). Consider adding a nameChangedRef or separate 'searchEnabled' per field.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG-660 primary fix (V1) is working. V5 has a regression where phone suggestions open after name edit. The issue is in CollectPaymentPanel.jsx phone search effect (L561-580) - tabIsCustomerSelected in deps means any field reset triggers phone search. Order #021115 for prashant is accessible via dashboard > Dine-In first card > Bill button. Do NOT submit/pay the order.
rca_of_v5_issue: Root cause: handleTabNameChange (L670-677) calls setTabIsCustomerSelected(false) via OD-660-03 logic. This triggers the phone search useEffect (L561-580) which has tabIsCustomerSelected in its dependency array [tabPhone, tabIsCustomerSelected, isTabPayment]. When tabIsCustomerSelected goes false and tabPhone='9535004327' (>=3 chars), CRM search fires for phone and returns prashant's record, showing the phone dropdown. Fix: Add a ref (e.g. lastEditedFieldRef) or track phone changes independently to guard phone search from running when only name changed.
